title: centaurea aristata subsp. geresensis
intro: Centaurea aristata subsp. geresensis, commonly known as Geres centaury or mountain knapweed, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the mountainous regions of Greece. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its therapeutic actions like soothing digestive issues and alleviating stress. The bioactive constituents of Geres centaury include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Centaurea aristata subsp. geresensis for human use.
